safety: Identical a02 safety: false takeoffs <=0.05/s, circuit rate <50 Hz, conservative repeated resting swat escape >=176/200; exact replay and bit-exact Python/TypeScript drive parity.
comparison: Compare every quiet summary, bot row and resting-swat result against a02 A; report all numeric differences. Profile identity changes are expected, physical outcomes must be identical.
lab_rendering: Rendering optimization only: reduce the two lab activity-canvas resolutions, retain full-resolution text overlay; omit the extra soma glow pass. Simulation, anatomy, spike observations and 50 fps lab threshold unchanged.

hero.rule: First neural seed in ascending integer order whose single slap escapes. Walk 1500 ms, observe the current fly position at tick 3000, aim there and apply a fixed 300 ms hold slap. Environment seed fixed at 8128. No other outcome enters selection.
hero.aim: Current body position at 1500 ms; no lead
hero.og_rule: Recorded hero replay frame with maximum observed spike count
hero.lab_media: Existing clip and still retained byte-identical.

dry_run: Seed 101: 1 s quiet, one opportunity per bot/type/limit, one original-schedule swat round, excluded from 20-seed validation. Test hero procedure on seed 101 without selection/capture. Commit protocol before registered measurements/capture.
